observations: Photo 0 is a professional stock image of an integrated fridge freezer.
The appliance is white with a bottom-mounted freezer.
The interior is shown fully stocked with food items.
No brand name or model number is visible on the appliance in the photo.
There is a watermark 'COLLINS COLLINS POSTED ON JIJI' across the image.

claims.evidence: The photo is a stock image and does not show any branding.

claims.claim: hold up to 10 bags of food

risks.risk: The photo is a stock image and may not represent the actual item for sale.
risks.proof: Photos of the actual item in its current location.

risks.risk: The appliance may have significant cosmetic damage or missing internal parts.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the exterior and interior of the actual unit.
risks.if_unproven: as heavily damaged and missing all shelves/drawers

risks.risk: The cooling system may be faulty or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit powered on with a thermometer inside showing a drop in temperature.

proof_requests: Photos of the actual item being sold, not a stock image.
A photo of the manufacturer's identification plate (usually inside the fridge or on the back) showing the model and serial number.
Photos of the door seals and the back of the unit (compressor area).
A video of the fridge plugged in and running.
response.reason: The seller has provided a stock photo rather than a photo of the actual item. It is impossible to verify the condition, brand, or even the existence of the specific unit without real photos.
